desc: Ideal for use in cars, trucks, vans, boats, in the office and at home. Mounting bracket can be mounted anywhere with included hardware can be secured without bracket by using the included 3' security cable. When box is locked it cannot be removed from the mounting bracket. Soft, durable scratch resistant interior. Deluxe key style lock. Heavy Duty steel construction with black matte powder finish. Exterior Dimensions 8.7" x 6" x 2.5". Interior Dimensions 7" x 5.25" x 2" 8".
